title: Youngest Self-made Billionaire and 3 Exceptional Runners-up
content:
Lucy Guo, co-founder of Scale AI, shares the spotlight. Raised in Fremont, California, steeped in immigrant Chinese culture, she taught herself to code at a young age. Guo eventually dropped out of college and launched a string of ventures.
In 2022, she told Fortune, "I have a swanky apartment in Miami and a house in LA which is five minutes away from my office" — big markers of success for many. But she also felt the pressure of turning 30 without having met cultural expectations of being married with kids by that age.
She’s a rare female tech CEO with a lifestyle that includes best friends, no kids, and a thriving office culture. She's openly grateful for her path but also deeply aware of the pressure that comes with such a title.
